children: Kering's results are difficult to interpret at a time when luxury groups face challenging demand trends, RBC Capital Markets analysts Piral Dadhania and Richard Chamberlain say. At the group level, the French luxury house booked revenue in line with consensus. However, the core Gucci brand reported a softer-than-expected retail performance. This makes the starting point for 4Q "more challenging than we previously thought," the analysts write in a research note. "The demand environment is challenging, which was always going to be a factor in Kering's equity story, even if it's outside of management's control," they say. Shares fall 13%. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
